GHOST_API_URL.description: Your own Ghost install. An address. The name is convention: Ghost documents the credentials, not variables for them.

GHOST_CONTENT_API_KEY.description: Ghost says these keys are safe for use in browsers and other insecure environments because they only ever reach public data. This is the clearest such statement in the registry.

GHOST_ADMIN_API_KEY.description: Ghost says it must be kept private and is unsuitable for browsers, unlike the Content key. Documented as an id and a secret separated by a colon. Regenerating replaces it at once, so update callers first.
